title: Gaussian noise difference quotient is square-integrable
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ belong to $L^2$ for product standard Gaussian measure. For every $t\ge0$, the function
\[x\longmapsto \frac{f(x)-T_{e^{-t}}f(x)}{t}\]
belongs to $L^2$ for that measure, where $T_\rho f(x)$ is the average of $f(\rho x+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,y)$ over standard Gaussian $y\in\mathbb R^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is square-integrable for product standard Gaussian measure
